title: Terraform storage module: snapshot lifecycle, encryption defaults, and runtime health probes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Deliver a single, opinionated Terraform module for Private (VPC) deployments that provisions EBS volumes, EFS filesystems, and S3 buckets with secure-by-default encryption, automated snapshot lifecycle policies, and lightweight runtime health probes to validate storage availability after provisioning and during upgrades. Scope includes: module variable surface, sane defaults for encryption (customer-managed CMKs via KMS), snapshot retention and scheduled snapshot policies, optional cross-account snapshot copy for DR, tagging and cost-center metadata, lifecycle rules for S3, and a small healthcheck subsystem that wires CloudWatch metrics + alarms and an SSM/Runbook integration for remediation. The module must be usable in hosted and on-prem Private deployments, integrate with our existing Terraform registry conventions, and include upgrade guidance for KMS key rotation and snapshot policy changes.
comments: 2025-11-14 - Aisha Patel: Created initial ticket. Motivation: bring storage provisioning to a hardened, audited module used across Private deployments. Initial ask covers EBS/EFS/S3, snapshots, encryption defaults, and health checks.

2025-12-02 - Architecture review (Marco, Leila): Agreed to prefer CMKs by default, expose a boolean to opt into AWS-managed keys, and to implement snapshot lifecycle via Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) for EBS and native Backup plans for EFS/S3 where appropriate. Add requirement to support cross-account snapshot copy for DR customers.

2026-01-05 - Security (Ravi): KMS policy templates submitted. Raised concern about least-privilege for snapshot copy role; suggested using a dedicated IAM role per environment instead of account-wide role. Marked security_review_required.

2026-01-25 - Eng (Marco): PoC module committed to internal registry namespace (registry.redwood.local/storage-module-poc). PoC uses null_resource + local-exec for a post-create mount/write test in staging; observed intermittent EFS mount failures due to DNS/VPC endpoint timing. Plan: add readiness probe with backoff and CloudWatch metric emission.

2026-02-20 - QA (Nina): End-to-end tests added in CI: create -> snapshot -> restore -> mount (EBS/EFS) and s3 put/get. Found an edge case where snapshot retention policy change caused unexpected snapshot deletions in orgs running cross-account copy. Added acceptance criteria to require a dry-run check and explicit approval step in CI when retention window shrinks.

2026-03-08 - PR open: gitlab.com/redwood-inference/infra/terraform-modules/storage-module MR !112. Requests: add sample upgrade guide for CMK rotation, and include example for importing existing volumes into module-managed state. Awaiting one more reviewer from platform reliability.
2026-03-10 - Marco Chen: Merged DLM policies to module and added CloudWatch dashboards for storage health. Scheduling docs review with Solutions on 2026-03-15.
acceptance_criteria: Module published to internal registry with semantic versioning and example usage for VPC-private deployments
All resources (EBS/EFS/S3) default to encryption with a customer-managed KMS key unless explicitly opted out
Snapshot lifecycle created (DLM / Backup plans) with configurable retention and optional cross-account copy; tests validate create->copy->restore workflows
Runtime health probes emit CloudWatch metrics and trigger SNS alarms when read/write or mount validations fail
CI tests include a dry-run gate for retention shrink operations to prevent accidental mass deletions
Upgrade docs describing KMS rotation, snapshot-to-state migration steps, and rollbacks are reviewed and checked into Confluence
Security review completed and IAM role least-privilege templates added to module variables
